name: this (inside a NordScript)
summary: Every script gets these. They are shortcuts to the objects below.
items: The entity the script is attached to.
The game: loadScene, restart, pause, camera, physics, ui…
Resolved attribute values (defaults merged with scene overrides, clamped).
{ delta, elapsed } in seconds (scaled by timeScale).
Physics adapter for the project's engine.
Animate numeric properties of an object or array. opts: duration, delay, ease, yoyo, repeat, onUpdate, onComplete. Returns cancel().

name: game
items: Load a scene file (default: project startScene). Destroys the current scene.
Number; 0.5 = slow motion. Applies to dt, timers and tweens.
Global bus. Built-in events: sceneLoad, sceneUnload, pause, resume, error, hotReload.
Errors caught from scripts so far.

name: game.camera
items: Use a `camera` component (free/orbit); `getComponent('camera').activate()` switches the current one. Effects: add a `postProcess` component.

name: game.physics
summary: Physics adapter. Methods differ slightly by engine; see the adapter pages.
items: Set velocity (2D px/s, 3D m/s). 2D: pass null to keep an axis.
Standing on something? (2D: touching a body below; 3D: short ray down.)
First hit {entity, point, normal, distance} or null.
Move a body without keeping velocity.

name: game.ui
summary: DOM UI layer drawn over the canvas (see the UI chapter). Works in 2D and 3D.
items: ui.label / button / panel / image / bar / menu
Create widgets. Each returns a handle with `el`, `remove()` and (label/bar) `set(value)`.
Show a named screen (layer). 'hud' is always created and shown.
Switch fonts and colours at runtime.

name: game.gui
summary: Babylon GUI bridge (3D only; null if the GUI library is not loaded).
items: Label that floats above an entity.
Link any control to an entity.

name: game.audio
items: Get/set a bus volume (master, music, sfx, ui). Persisted.

name: game.save
summary: Persistent key/value storage in slots (localStorage; versioned).

name: entity.native
summary: Escape hatch: the underlying engine object. Only reach for it when Nord has no wrapper.
items: Raw engine objects on many runtime components.
